Exercises.Disclaimer: Use only the exercises approved for you by your clinician. Stop if you feel pain, dizziness, or sudden weakness.

SitToStand.Name: Sit to stand
SitToStand.Description: Builds functional leg strength for controlled transfers.
SitToStand.Instructions: Sit near the front of a stable chair. Place both feet under your knees, lean forward, and stand slowly. Reach back and sit down with control.
SitToStand.Safety: Keep the chair behind you and use the armrests or a stable support if needed. Do not rush or let the knees collapse inward.

SupportedKneeRaise.Name: Supported knee raise
SupportedKneeRaise.Description: Trains hip flexion and weight shifting while standing.
SupportedKneeRaise.Instructions: Stand tall while holding a stable support. Slowly lift one knee, lower it, then repeat on the other side.
SupportedKneeRaise.Safety: Keep both hands or the prescribed support available. Keep your trunk upright and stop if balance becomes unsafe.

SeatedKneeExtension.Name: Seated knee extension
SeatedKneeExtension.Description: Activates the quadriceps through a controlled seated movement.
SeatedKneeExtension.Instructions: Sit upright with both feet supported. Slowly straighten one knee, pause briefly, then lower the foot with control.
SeatedKneeExtension.Safety: Move only through the comfortable range prescribed by your clinician. Do not kick or lock the knee forcefully.

HeelRaises.Name: Supported heel raises
HeelRaises.Description: Strengthens the calf muscles for standing and walking support.
HeelRaises.Instructions: Stand behind a stable chair or counter. Rise onto your toes slowly, pause, and lower both heels with control.
HeelRaises.Safety: Use the support throughout. Keep weight even and do not perform this exercise unsupported if balance is limited.

StraightLegRaise.Name: Straight-leg raise
StraightLegRaise.Description: Builds front-thigh control without repeated knee bending.
StraightLegRaise.Instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight. Tighten the thigh, lift the straight leg slowly, then lower it.
StraightLegRaise.Safety: Keep the knee straight without forcing it. Stop if pain increases or the leg cannot be controlled.

HeelSlides.Name: Heel slides
HeelSlides.Description: Gently practices knee bending and straightening in a supported position.
HeelSlides.Instructions: Lie on your back. Slide one heel toward your body to bend the knee, then slide it away slowly to straighten.
HeelSlides.Safety: Stay within the comfortable range and never force the knee into pain or a hard stop.

QuadSet.Name: Static quadriceps set
QuadSet.Description: Rebuilds the ability to activate the front-thigh muscles.
QuadSet.Instructions: Lie or sit with the leg straight. Tighten the front of the thigh by gently pressing the knee down, hold briefly, and relax.
QuadSet.Safety: Use a small, comfortable contraction. Do not hold your breath or press so hard that pain increases.

SupportedHipExtension.Name: Supported hip extension
SupportedHipExtension.Description: Strengthens the hip extensors while standing with support.
SupportedHipExtension.Instructions: Hold a stable support with your trunk upright. Move one straight leg gently backward without arching your back, then return slowly.
SupportedHipExtension.Safety: Keep the movement small and controlled. Do not lean forward or perform without support if balance is limited.

Walk.Name: Walking
Walk.Description: Practices steady, controlled walking with the exoskeleton.
Walk.Instructions: Stand tall with the prescribed support. Take slow, even steps and keep your gaze forward.
Walk.Safety: Use supervision and support as prescribed. Stop if you feel pain, dizziness, or loss of balance.

RaiseLeftLeg.Name: Raise left leg
RaiseLeftLeg.Description: Builds controlled lifting strength in the left leg.
RaiseLeftLeg.Instructions: Hold a stable support, lift the left leg slowly, pause, and lower it with control.
RaiseLeftLeg.Safety: Keep your trunk upright and avoid swinging. Stop if balance or pain worsens.

RaiseRightLeg.Name: Raise right leg
RaiseRightLeg.Description: Builds controlled lifting strength in the right leg.
RaiseRightLeg.Instructions: Hold a stable support, lift the right leg slowly, pause, and lower it with control.
RaiseRightLeg.Safety: Keep your trunk upright and avoid swinging. Stop if balance or pain worsens.

KickLeftLeg.Name: Kick left leg
KickLeftLeg.Description: Practices a controlled forward movement of the left leg.
KickLeftLeg.Instructions: Hold support, extend the left leg gently forward, then return slowly.
KickLeftLeg.Safety: Use a small range and never snap the knee. Keep support within reach.

KickRightLeg.Name: Kick right leg
KickRightLeg.Description: Practices a controlled forward movement of the right leg.
KickRightLeg.Instructions: Hold support, extend the right leg gently forward, then return slowly.
KickRightLeg.Safety: Use a small range and never snap the knee. Keep support within reach.

KickLeftKnee.Name: Kick left knee
KickLeftKnee.Description: Practices controlled left knee lifting and extension.
KickLeftKnee.Instructions: Hold support, lift the left knee as prescribed, extend gently, and return slowly.
KickLeftKnee.Safety: Do not force the range or lock the knee. Stop if pain or instability appears.

KickRightKnee.Name: Kick right knee
KickRightKnee.Description: Practices controlled right knee lifting and extension.
KickRightKnee.Instructions: Hold support, lift the right knee as prescribed, extend gently, and return slowly.
KickRightKnee.Safety: Do not force the range or lock the knee. Stop if pain or instability appears.
